individual-data-points.explanation: Panel A is a micrograph/spatial map, not a plot of averaged data.

error-bars-defined.explanation: Panel A is not a plot, so error bars do not apply.

individual-data-points.explanation: Panel B shows H&E histology images, not a plot of averaged data.

error-bars-defined.explanation: Panel B is not a plot, so error bars do not apply.

individual-data-points.explanation: The spatial expression overlays show per-spot (per-location) expression values across the tissue rather than a group average with error, so individual data point display is not applicable in the classical sense.

error-bars-defined.explanation: The spatial expression heatmaps display raw per-spot expression intensity (a continuous color scale), not an averaged value with error bars, so no error bar definition is required.

individual-data-points.explanation: GSEA enrichment plots display a running enrichment score curve derived from ranked gene lists, not an averaged summary statistic across replicates, so individual data points are not applicable.

error-bars-defined.explanation: GSEA enrichment plots show a single running-score curve per gene set with NES/FDR/p statistics; there are no error bars to define.

individual-data-points.explanation: The bar graph shows log2 fold-change values per gene from a differential expression analysis (Seurat FindMarkers) without displaying the underlying individual spot/sample-level data points or any replicate distribution.

error-bars-defined.explanation: The bar graph reports single log2 fold-change values with associated p-values from a statistical test (Wilcoxon rank-sum, Bonferroni corrected) rather than a mean with variance, so no error bars are expected or shown.
